address: 8 place de Strasbourg, Les Sables-d'Olonne, 85100, France
bio: You can expect a warm welcome with the bonus of a sea view from Estelle and Maxime Dourdin. The chef, formerly of establishments of the calibre of the Four Seasons George V in Paris, signs a single set menu that changes frequently depending on market availability. Unusual, well-crafted dishes in the zeitgeist, such as mussels in white wine, jalapeno sauce, fermented milk and herb-flavoured tapioca....
